subject: Emotions
title: Endorphin Rushes
description: A micro-lesson that makes Endorphin Rushes usable.

hook.text: A marathon runner hits mile 20 and suddenly feels invincible. The 'runner's high' is the brain's own morphine.

buildup.text: Endorphins are natural opioids produced during pain, exercise, and excitement. They suppress pain and boost mood.

discovery.text: Laughter produces endorphins too. Fifteen minutes of comedy raises pain tolerance by 10%, measured in lab studies.

twist.text: Spicy food triggers endorphins because capsaicin signals pain. You feel joy from chili because your brain senses hurt.

climax.text: Endorphins reward survival behavior: exercise, bonding, laughter, eating. Joy is the brain's thank-you note.

punchline.text: The body manufactures its own drugs—for free.

quiz.question: Why does spicy food trigger endorphins?
